Lemma
[Upper-half-space visual measure] \group extensions Source: thurston:page-0303

In the upper half-space model, if $x=(z_0,h)$ and a geodesic from $x$ meets $\mathbb C$ at radial distance $r$, then \[ r=h\cot (\theta /2),\qquad dV_x=4\left(h+\frac{r^2}{h}\right)^{-2}d\mu . \] The boundary field induced by a tangent vector $X$ at $x$ is the restriction of the infinitesimal hyperbolic translation in direction $X$.
Proof

\sketch Differentiate $r=h\cot (\theta /2)$ to obtain $dr=-\frac12(h+r^2/h)d\theta $. Conformality of the visual map then gives the displayed density. The translation description follows either from the disk model or, for a vertical unit vector, from $-\sin \theta \, \partial _\theta =r\, \partial _r$.

□
